title: Darrow Hill
wikitext:
[[Image:Darrow Hill.jpg|thumb|300px|Darrow Hill.]]

'''Darrow Hill''' is an area in the northern part of the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], beneath the [[Headland]] of [[Alterac Mountain]]. [[Mountain lion]]s and [[stag]]s roam its fields, and [[yeti]]s inhabit the [[Foothill Caverns]]. [[Alterac Granite]] can be found within the cave found here.
